በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ለምድር: ምድር — to/for the earth, or earth as object (ለ- + noun)
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ትመስል: መሰለ — she resembles, is like (3f sg imperfect, m-s-l)
ኬንያ: ኬንያ — craftsman, maker (noun; uncertain, sense from context)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')
ለማኅደረ: ማኅደር — for the dwelling of (ለ- 'for' + noun, construct)
ታንሶሱ: አንሶሰወ — she walks about (3fs imperfect, quadriliteral አንሶሰወ)
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
ምድረ: ምድር — land, earth (noun, f.; construct 'land of' / accusative)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
ዲባጋተ: ዲባግ — brocade, fine garment (noun, plural accusative; uncertain)
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun)
ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of')
ወበኀበ: ኀበ — and before, with (ወ- + በ- + ኀበ)
ወይትናገሮሙ: ተናገረ — and he would speak with them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, reciprocal ተ- stem, n-g-r; + -ሙ 'them', joined by -o-)
ሎሙ: ለ — to them (preposition ለ- with 3mp suffix: ሎሙ)
ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r)
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — of/for the king of (ለ- + construct)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun; construct 'son of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደ ታራ ወልደ 'Terah begot a son'; ch. 13)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
በኰሩ: በኵር — his firstborn (noun + -u 'his'; ሮቤል በኰሩ ለያዕቆብ 'Reuben, his firstborn, Jacob's')
